documents.text: My name is John and I run a digital marketing agency called GrowthLab. We help SaaS companies grow their user base through content marketing and SEO. Our core values are transparency, data-driven decisions, and creative excellence. I struggle with time management and delegating tasks. My weekly workflow includes content planning on Mondays, client calls on Tuesdays and Thursdays, and analytics review on Fridays.
